exceptions.reason: WO-40 Amendment 11f (R13a)/O-20: KEV exception, approved in principle by the owner on 2026-11-13. CVE-2026-123158 (NVD published 2026-11-05, CVSS 3.1 8.1; CISA KEV since 2026-11-09): sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, accepts some long passwords for some account configurations. Evidence (architect, 2026-11-13, from the scan SBOM and a digest-verified static read of the image): this Argo CD image is Ubuntu 26.04 with glibc 2.43 and libpam0g; it ships openssh-client 1:10.2p1-2ubuntu3.7 only, with no openssh-server package and no sshd. Argo CD pulls the Twinfra repository over HTTPS only. The scanner matches the CVE to the openssh source package and lists no fix. This is evidence that the vulnerable configuration is absent; no claim of non-exploitability. Duty: re-check at each weekly watch; promote an eligible Argo CD image without this finding under the KEV expedite rule, then close this row. Expiry 2026-12-13 is fixed (30 days). No automatic renewal.
